news.title: Musk's SpaceX bonus comes with unique condition: colonize Mars
news.summary: SpaceX's blockbuster IPO filing included some out of this world details, including a provision that founder Elon Musk's massive bonus only kicks in if one million humans settle on Mars. Musk's bonus is contingent on SpaceX's stock market value hitting targets ranging from $400 billion to $6 trillion

news.title: Max Healthcare Q4 results: Cons PAT grows 7% YoY to Rs 342 crore, revenue rises 12%
news.summary: Max Healthcare Q4FY26 consolidated PAT grew 7% YoY, and revenue increased 12%. Network EBITDA rose 8%. Max Lab and Max@Home saw strong double-digit growth. The company also recommended a final dividend of Rs 2 per equity share for the year.

news.title: US stocks today: US stocks slips as oil jumps on renewed Mideast concerns
news.summary: Wall Street slipped as oil prices jumped after Iran signaled a tougher nuclear stance, raising fears of prolonged supply disruption. Rising Treasury yields and weak corporate cues, including Walmart’s outlook, added pressure, offsetting strong economic data.

news.title: LIC announces 1:1 bonus issue, sets May 29 as record date
news.summary: LIC announced a 1:1 bonus issue, setting May 29 as the record date for eligibility. This follows Q4 earnings showing a 23% YoY rise in consolidated net profit, reaching Rs 23,467 crore. A final dividend of Rs 10 per share for FY 2025-26 was also recommended.

news.title: Grasim Industries among 7 large-cap stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 25% in a month
news.summary: ​Seven large-cap stocks from the BSE 100 index, including Grasim Industries, hit 52-week highs despite the weak Sensex. These stocks showed strong bullish momentum, rallying up to 25% over the past month.​

news.title: Embassy Developments posts Rs 323 cr net loss in Mar quarter
news.summary: Its total income fell to Rs 407.20 crore in the fourth quarter of 2025-26 fiscal from Rs 1,182.61 crore in the corresponding period of the preceding year, according to a regulatory filing on Wednesday.

news.title: GAIL Q4FY26 Results: Net profit drops 41% YoY to ₹1,481 crore, revenue slips 2.3%; final dividend announced
news.summary: GAIL (India) reported a weak performance for Q4FY26, with revenue declining 2.3% to ₹35,705 crore and net profit falling 41% year-on-year to ₹1,481 crore. Despite challenges, profit from associates increased, while annual revenue remained flat at ₹1.42 lakh crore.

news.title: Multibagger defence stock surges over 100% in less than two months. Are you holding it?
news.summary: Apollo Micro Systems shares hit a record high of ₹377.70, driven by strong growth prospects and investor demand. The stock has rebounded 110% since March, showcasing robust annual returns and significant quarterly revenue growth, despite a previous decline.
